purpose: Test whether deterministic same-block or same-source navigation improves required-evidence localization over a stronger lexical baseline under the same 40-Claim candidate budget.
interpretation: Revealed Batch C evaluator Gold makes this a post-hoc mechanism diagnostic, not blind product evidence.
allowedImplementationChangeBeforeRun: Add an explicit pathKinds filter to structural candidate discovery, applied before aggregation and budget. It must preserve the default both-path behavior and pass full regression.

arms.definition: Top 10 persistent lexical Seeds. Descriptive only; not the primary same-budget comparator.
Top 40 persistent lexical candidates. Primary same-budget comparator.
Top 10 lexical Seeds plus up to 30 unique SAME_EVIDENCE_BLOCK candidates.
Top 10 lexical Seeds plus up to 20 unique SAME_EVIDENCE_BLOCK candidates, then up to 10 unique SAME_SOURCE-only candidates.

decisionRules.BLOCK_SIGNAL: At S50 L10_BLOCK30 has required source and exact-quote recall >= L40_STRONG, at least one strict per-question source or quote win, zero per-question source and quote losses, <=40 candidates, average evidence closure tokens <=110% of L40, and P95 latency <= max(2x L40, L40+50ms).
decisionRules.SOURCE_MARGINAL_SIGNAL: At S50 L10_BLOCK20_SOURCE10 satisfies the BLOCK_SIGNAL safety/cost conditions and has more matched required sources or quotes than L10_BLOCK30 with zero per-question source/quote losses versus L10_BLOCK30.
decisionRules.SCALE_STABILITY: A passing structural arm at S50 loses no more than 0.05 aggregate exact-quote recall from its own S12 result.
decisionRules.NO_STRUCTURAL_BENEFIT: Neither structural arm beats L40_STRONG on any required source or exact quote at S50 under the fixed budget.
decisionRules.REWORK: Any apparent recall gain requires >10% average evidence closure token overhead, violates the 40-Claim budget, or introduces per-question required source/quote losses not offset by a separately reported tradeoff.

stopRules: Do not generate answers or modify Context Pack in this run.
Do not tune path quotas after reading the report; any new quota is a new contract/run.
Preserve the first report directory and hash; fixes must use a new run id.
